posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
There have been threads about this - I Googled "rpg maker mv window transparency":
Non transparent window skins?
Is it possible to make a solid background window skin in RMMV? If so, how?   	Thanks.
forums.rpgmakerweb.com
Making the windowskin non-transparent
Hiya guys!  I wonder if you could make the standard windowskin non-transparent, as I don't like it the way it is at the moment. I was hoping I won't need a script, so I posted it here.   If I do, I'll try in the Script Request Section again.  I've put a screenshot up, so it's understandable what...
forums.rpgmakerweb.com
Note the second link contains the very bad advice of editing your rpg_scenes file. Don't do that. Copy the function to a new file, make the modifications, and save it as a *.js file to include as a plugin.
Thusly:
Code:
Window_Base.prototype.standardBackOpacity = function() 
{
    return 255;
};
